concerns.text: T014c (Train Baseline) depends on T023a (ECFP Collinearity Check). However, T023a depends on T010 (Split). The dependency chain T014c -> T023a -> T010 is valid, but T014c also lists T008.1 and T010.5 as dependencies. T010.5 (Merge Split) depends on T010. The ordering is logically sound, but T014c is marked [X] (completed) while its dependencies T023a and T010 are marked [ ] (incomplete). This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule: a task cannot be marked complete if it depends on incomplete tasks that produce its required input artifacts.

T015a (Train GNN) is marked [X] (completed) but depends on T008.1, T010.5, and T014a. T008.1 and T010.5 are marked [ ] (incomplete). A task cannot be executed (or marked complete) before its data inputs (cleaned/split data) are produced by upstream tasks.

T023b (GNN Redundancy) depends on T015a (Trained Model). T015a is marked [X] (completed), but T023b is marked [X] (completed) as well. However, T023b also depends on T015a which is logically correct, but the status flags are inconsistent: if T015a is complete, T023b should be executable, but T023b is marked complete while T024 (Raw Attribution) which it feeds into is incomplete. The flow T023b -> T025 -> T027 is broken because T024 is incomplete.

T025 (Apply Masking) depends on T023b and T024. T024 (GNNExplainer) is marked [~] (partial/incomplete). T025 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is a valid dependency chain, but the status of T024 ([~]) suggests it is partially done, yet T025 cannot proceed. The ordering is correct, but the 'Producer' (T024) is not fully ready, blocking the 'Consumer' (T025).

T027 (Aggregate Results) depends on T016, T016.1, T018, T023a, T023b, T024, T025, T026a. T016.1, T018, T024, T025, T026a are all marked [ ] (incomplete). T027 is marked [ ] (incomplete). The dependency list is correct, but the task cannot be executed until all these producers are complete. The status flags are consistent with the dependencies, but the overall flow is blocked by multiple incomplete upstream tasks.

T047.2 (Final Verified Accuracy Gate) depends on T047.1 and T009.1. T047.1 depends on T047 and T009.1. T047 depends on T008 and T044. T008 is marked [X] (completed), T044 is [ ] (incomplete). T047 is [ ] (incomplete). T047.1 is [ ] (incomplete). T047.2 is [ ] (incomplete). The dependency chain is valid, but the gate cannot be executed because T044 (Verify metrics.json) is incomplete. This is a valid ordering, but the 'Producer' (T044) is missing.

T014c (Train Baseline) depends on T023a (ECFP Collinearity). T023a is marked [ ] (incomplete). T014c is marked [X] (completed). This is a direct violation: a task marked complete cannot depend on an incomplete task that produces a required input (collinearity flags). The 'Producer' (T023a) must precede the 'Consumer' (T014c) in completion status.

T015a (Train GNN) is marked [X] (completed) but depends on T008.1 (SC-003 Validation) and T010.5 (Merge Split). Both T008.1 and T010.5 are marked [ ] (incomplete). This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule: the training task cannot be complete if the data preparation tasks it consumes are incomplete.

T023b (GNN Redundancy) is marked [X] (completed) but depends on T015a (Trained Model). T015a is marked [X] (completed). This is consistent. However, T023b also depends on T015a which is correct. The issue is that T023b is marked complete while T024 (Raw Attribution) which it feeds into is incomplete. This is not a dependency violation, but a flow blockage. The real issue is T023b's status: if it depends on T015a, and T015a is complete, T023b can be complete. But T023b is marked complete while T024 is incomplete, which is fine. The problem is T025 depends on T023b and T024. T024 is incomplete, so T025 cannot be complete. This is consistent. The real violation is T014c and T015a being marked complete while their dependencies are incomplete.

T008.1 (SC-003 Validation) depends on T008 (Ingest). T008 is marked [X] (completed). T008.1 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is valid. However, T010 (Split) depends on T008.1. T010 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The issue is that T014c and T015a depend on T008.1 and T010.5, which are incomplete, yet T014c and T015a are marked complete. This is the core violation.

T010.5 (Merge Split) depends on T008.1 and T010. Both are marked [ ] (incomplete). T010.5 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The violation is that downstream tasks (T014c, T015a) depend on T010.5 but are marked complete.

T016 (Evaluate) depends on T018 (Power Analysis). T018 is marked [ ] (incomplete). T016 is marked [X] (completed). This is a direct violation: the evaluation task cannot be complete if the power analysis (which determines the statistical test to use) is incomplete. The 'Producer' (T018) must precede the 'Consumer' (T016).

T016.1 (Narrative) depends on T016. T016 is marked [X] (completed). T016.1 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The issue is that T016 is marked complete while its dependency T018 is incomplete.

T026a (Sensitivity Sweep) is marked [ ] (incomplete). T026b (Generate Report) depends on T026a. T026b is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The issue is that T027 depends on T026a, and T027 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The real violation is in T014c, T015a, and T016 being marked complete while their dependencies are incomplete.

T048 (Compute Budget Re-Verification) depends on T015b, T041, T047.2. T015b is marked [ ] (incomplete). T041 is marked [ ] (incomplete). T047.2 is marked [ ] (incomplete). T048 is marked [X] (completed). This is a direct violation: a task cannot be complete if its dependencies are incomplete. The 'Producer' tasks (T015b, T041, T047.2) must precede the 'Consumer' (T048).

T049 (Attribution Consistency) depends on T023b and T025. T023b is marked [X] (completed). T025 is marked [ ] (incomplete). T049 is marked [ ] (incomplete). This is consistent. The issue is that T025 is incomplete, so T049 cannot be complete. This is consistent. The real violation is in T014c, T015a, T016, and T048 being marked complete while their dependencies are incomplete.
